initialization: The exact saved v45 random checkpoint for each seed; no trained or external borrowed weights
trained_changes: Generator only. Frozen v45 global-diversity architecture, base/local/InfoNCE/variance objectives, optimizer and clipping are called unchanged.
positive_invariances: Same components/count/relative geometry under mild axis-preserving affine pose, linewidth/envelope/gain/colored-noise changes; component frequency geometry unchanged by appearance.
negative_nuisance_control: Positive and all edited queries share background/pose/gain/width; each foreground RMS normalized before shared intensity transform.
input: Native256x2561-second time/log-frequency10–2048Hz, downsample128x128full and nativebottomthird enlarged128x128low; RGB channels identical. No axes, timestamps, text or borders.
synthetic_models: All9 matched random3/v45global3/v46spectrogram3 evaluated once on each new set after training; no test-driven selection.
real_scope: Root evaluates only previously consumed USED data with fixed one positive reference and negative FIT/CAL. Separate one-second/four-duration ablation. No new real holdout or claims of confirmed discoveries.
limitations: Domain-motivated power-ridge simulator rather than universal image generator.
New latent test identities share their respective grammars and renderer.
Four edits per identity are dependent and three seeds are not additional test images.
Soft variance regularization does not mathematically remove the exact constant stationary point.
Changes in generator distribution include primitive shapes and nuisance statistics; this ablation cannot separate those internally.
